findings.reproduction: Approve the simulated model proposal for “focus on the bottle if anybody opens it”; process two owned JPEGs with a scripted bottle track. Exercise an unconfigured Teacher, a closed/negative observation, and a provider error.
findings.expected: Unavailable or uncalibrated opening semantics remain unsupported/unknown and cannot authorize an opening-conditioned action.
findings.actual: All three cases create an event and notification titled Bottle opening. The observation never gates dispatch; an absent Teacher produces no unavailable observation. Keeping the condition in visual_observation does not preserve its execution semantics.
findings.fix: Reject or clarify unsupported semantic conditional tasks. Keep weak observations informational; offer geometric presence monitoring only as a separately disclosed and approved task.

findings.reproduction: Open camera/judge sockets, then logout or expire the session. Send another frame or update the feed. Also rebind a judge to room B while its room A socket remains open. Logout failures were reproduced over actual uvicorn/TCP.
findings.expected: Revocation, expiry and changed room membership stop camera ingestion and private feed delivery.
findings.actual: HTTP returns 401/403, but the existing camera socket accepts another frame and the judge receives new private bytes. Rebinding retains old-room socket access. Authorization is checked only at handshake.
findings.fix: Close associated sockets on logout, expiry and rebinding; revalidate authoritative session, role and membership before receive/send. Stop frontend 4401 reconnect loops and request reauthentication.

findings.reproduction: With an exact origin allowlist configured, login without Origin, with matching attacker Origin/Host, or with the wrong scheme. Open camera sockets without Origin or the CSRF cookie. Logout with hostile Origin and no CSRF header.
findings.expected: Configured Origin/Host policy is authoritative; mutations and upgrades enforce the specified Origin and CSRF boundaries.
findings.actual: The logins, mutation, deficient upgrades and logout succeed. Caller-controlled Host matching bypasses the allowlist. Logout lacks the mutation guard, and WebSocket authentication does not check the CSRF cookie.
findings.fix: Validate the deployment host and exact origin using trusted proxy metadata. Require allowed Origin on mutations/upgrades, protect logout, and validate the required WebSocket CSRF token/cookie.

findings.reproduction: From one actual TCP client, submit seven wrong PINs while changing X-Forwarded-For on each request.
findings.expected: Untrusted forwarding headers cannot evade the five-failure PIN limit.
findings.actual: All seven attempts return 401 instead of lockout 429. The handler trusts the first supplied XFF address; the entrypoint trusts forwarding from every peer.
findings.fix: Configure the trusted proxy chain, strip or replace untrusted forwarding headers, and rate-limit by verified client identity. Bound and prune failure-key storage. External cloudflared header rewriting remains NOT TESTED.

findings.reproduction: Send empty camera bytes, a small 1200×64 JPEG declared as 320×240, sequences 9/9/8, NaN capture_ts, and 512-KiB HTTP JSON/WebSocket metadata. Exercise the empty frame through actual TCP and the production worker loop.
findings.expected: Validate bounded payloads, decoded dimensions, finite metadata and increasing sequence numbers; malformed frames must not terminate processing.
findings.actual: Empty bytes raise cv2.error and kill the sole worker while health remains ok. Oversize decoded dimensions reach inference; duplicate/stale frames are accepted; NaN events make state return 500. Oversize JSON and metadata are accepted.
findings.fix: Enforce pre-parse body/text limits and strict metadata; inspect JPEG dimensions before inference; reject empty, invalid, nonfinite and stale input. Catch per-frame worker failures and expose worker liveness in readiness.

findings.reproduction: Create rooms with nine fresh camera sessions, logging each owner out immediately with no remaining judges.
findings.expected: Orphaned rooms, pairing codes and retained media retire and release capacity for later users.
findings.actual: Eight creations return 200; the ninth returns 503. Production code never calls close_room. Room memberships and evidence lack lifecycle/TTL cleanup.
findings.fix: Wire logout, session expiry and idle/retention deadlines to room retirement, pairing/media cleanup and evidence deletion. Remove expired judge memberships and release capacity.

findings.reproduction: Activate, disable, re-enable and process three frames. Separately pause/resume while inference is held, then release it. POST enabled="false" and render a disabled task in the frontend.
findings.expected: Re-enable restores processing without resetting the camera; pause invalidates old work; controls are typed and expose re-enable.
findings.actual: Re-enable reports running with zero engines and no alerts. Pause/resume preserves the generation, allowing old inference to notify after the pause ACK. String "false" enables the task. The disabled UI has no re-enable control.
findings.fix: Use strict Boolean request models, invalidate execution generations on revocation, rebuild engines on re-enable/resume with explicit timing semantics, and provide a re-enable control for the approved task.

findings.reproduction: Pause the production httpcore socket write before POST headers, complete HTTP task disable, then resume the actual write to an owned loopback Teacher fixture.
findings.expected: No new Teacher image request starts after disable acknowledgment.
findings.actual: One actual POST containing two JPEGs arrives after disable ACK. The final version check cancels the local notification but does not protect private frame admission.
findings.fix: Carry an authoritative room/task generation guard into Teacher admission and serialize its check with the actual first write and disable acknowledgment. Recheck after semaphore waiting and cancel unsent work.

findings.reproduction: Trickle an actual Teacher response every 20 ms under a 60-ms timeout. Hold Teacher and planner admission for 120 ms under 40-ms timeouts; intercept planner subprocess execution.
findings.expected: One overall deadline includes admission and completion; expired waiting work cannot start provider calls.
findings.actual: Teacher returns ok after 282.5 ms. A Teacher POST starts after admission expiry, and the planner reaches the intercepted subprocess boundary after 120 ms. The per-operation httpx timeout permits a paced response to stall the sole CV worker.
findings.fix: Use one absolute monotonic deadline across admission and transport/process phases, recompute remaining time, bound responses and terminate expired work. Retain concurrency capacity until underlying work ends.

findings.reproduction: Send twelve malformed confidence fixtures through actual HTTP to /probe. Return the committed local Teacher occupancy-scoring envelope for an opening/closed request. Change room, labels and model while retaining image/question.
findings.expected: Strict confidence and requested-label validation; unsupported capabilities return unknown. Cache identity preserves scope, schema and model provenance.
findings.actual: Boolean, string, out-of-range and missing confidence becomes ok or raw fallback; NaN/infinities cause 500. Occupancy scoring is accepted for an opening question. Requested labels are not sent. Changed room/model/schema reuses the first observation.
findings.fix: Validate a bounded typed provider contract, reject malformed confidence and out-of-schema labels, preserve actual scoring/model/revision/usage, reject unsupported questions, and scope/version cache identity appropriately.

findings.reproduction: Execute the committed Judges script with a delayed simulated plan response. Edit the prompt while planning, then resolve the old response.
findings.expected: Every edit invalidates pending approval, including in-flight planning.
findings.actual: The edit handler only clears an existing draft. The late response installs the obsolete task and reveals Approve & activate.
findings.fix: Track prompt/request generations, invalidate approval immediately on edit/discard/new planning, and discard stale responses. Bind approval to the displayed canonical task.
